common.footerDisclaimer: Demo prototype. Synthetic data. Not connected to any government or bank system.

landing.heroSubline: Land records, loans, scheme entitlements and discrepancy resolution in one transparent ledger.
landing.demoDataNotice: All metrics and farmer accounts are synthetic demo data.
landing.step1Desc: Land registry, bank loan ledgers, and welfare databases combined without manual paperwork.
landing.step2Desc: Algorithmic audit flags owner name mismatches, duplicate survey numbers, and dormant accounts.
landing.step3Desc: Farmers file one-click pre-filled grievances while bank officers verify claims in seconds.
landing.feature1Desc: Live Kisan Credit Card limit, MSP price bonus verification, and crop insurance tracking.
landing.feature2Desc: Immediate alert when revenue records and bank registries mismatch, preventing subsidy freeze.
landing.feature3Desc: Generates tamper-evident receipt numbers and downloadable PDF slips for physical follow-up.
landing.feature4Desc: Fast cross-reference for branch officers with instant mismatch detection and audit trails.
